name: Vigor 11 · Appointment Booking & Approval Email Automation

parameters.content:
## 11 · Appointment Booking & Approval Email Automation

**Top Branch:** Patient books appointment.
- Webhook: `POST /webhook/vigor/appointment-booked`
- Auto-sends email: **"Your appointment request has been received. Please wait for doctor approval."**

**Bottom Branch:** Doctor approves appointment in Doctor Portal.
- Webhook: `POST /webhook/vigor/appointment-approved`
- Auto-sends email: **"Your appointment has been approved."** with confirmed date & time and video meeting URL.

'ar' : 'en'; const subject = locale === 'ar' ? `تم استلام طلب موعدك بنجاح - بانتظار موافقة الطبيب [${bookingId}]` : `Your Appointment Request Has Been Received [${bookingId}]`; const html = ` ${subject}

V I G O R   A I

Abu Dhabi Precision Clinical Telehealth

● Status: Pending Approval

Your appointment request has been received. Please wait for doctor approval.

Booking Ref: ${bookingId}

👤 Patient: ${patientName}

👨‍⚕️ Physician: ${doctorName}

🏥 Facility: ${facilityName}

🗓️ Requested Time: ${slotTime}

${isVideo ? '📹' : '🏥'} Modality: ${isVideo ? 'Telehealth Video Consultation' : 'In-Person Hospital Visit'}

Next Step: The clinician is reviewing available appointment schedules. As soon as approved, you will receive an official approval email.
`; return [{ json: { ok: true, eventType: 'appointment.request_received', recipientEmail, patientName, bookingId, doctorName, facilityName, slotTime, consultType, subject, htmlBody: html, dispatchedAt: new Date().toISOString() } }];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, status: 'Pending', message: 'Your appointment request has been received. Please wait for doctor approval.', email: $json.recipientEmail, bookingId: $json.bookingId }) }}
